newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Berjaya says buy stake in Alpha.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Berjaya says buy stake in Alpha.

text.p: Malaysia's Berjaya Group Bhd said on Tuesday its wholly-owned subsidiary has acquired 13.0 million shares or a 12.52 percent equity stake in Australia's Alpha Healthcare Ltd for A$2.17 million.
In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, Berjaya said its Berjaya Group Equity (Cayman) Ltd has also proposed to subscribe for a further 9.55 million Alpha shares for A$1.91 million.
Alpha owns and operates five hospitals in Australia with a total of 331 beds.
Berjaya said the Cayman unit has also proposed to sell the entire 13.0 million Alpha shares to Berjaya's associate, Hospital Pantai Bhd, for A$2.6 million.
Berjaya will also sell the entire issued and paid-up capital of Healthcare Holdings (Cayman) Ltd, a wholly-owned unit of Berjaya Group Equity, to Pantai for US$10,000.
The restructurings will result in Pantai holding indirectly a total of 19.88 percent equity stake in Alpha, diversified Berjaya said.
